weather.profile_method: mean of sorted annual temperature profiles mapped to the rank chronology of reference year 2025
weather.solar_profile_method: mean of sorted annual global-radiation profiles mapped to the rank chronology of reference year 2025; FG_LBERG converted from J/cm2 to kWh/m2 without fixed annual normalization
weather.source: DWD Climate Data Center hourly air-temperature observations
weather.solar_source: DWD Climate Data Center hourly solar observations (FG_LBERG)
weather.design_method: 10th independent two-day cold-event mean in the latest available 20-year station period
weather.ground_method: DWD mean observed soil temperature at 100 cm from Hannover (latest 20-year period)
